title: Resident Referral Program — Credit Amount, Qualifying Period and Annual Cap
content:
A resident under an Independent Living Residency Agreement who refers a new independent living resident may earn an account credit. The program figures are the same for every apartment type.

| Apartment type of the referring resident | Account credit per qualifying referral | Days the referred resident must have been in residence | Most referral credits to one resident in a rolling 12-month window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 1,500.00 | 60 | 2 |

Credit amount written plainly: 1500.00 US dollars per qualifying referral.

## Reading the figures

- The credit is an account credit to the resident who made the referral.
- The qualifying period is a number of calendar days the referred resident must have been in residence before the credit is granted.
- The cap counts referral credits granted to one resident within a rolling 12-month window.

Hypothetical example: three qualifying referrals within one rolling 12-month window would earn at most two credits of 1,500.00, a total of 3,000.00.
